conditions.detail: goal_id and goal_revision must equal the values the host issued for this WorkItem
proposal_id values must be unique within the plan and must not be durable Task ids
every required request completion criterion must appear exactly once in criterion_bindings
dependencies must reference proposal ids in this plan, must not self-reference, and must be acyclic
allowed_paths must stay inside the Goal execution root; LOCAL_MUTATION/HOST_NATIVE_APPROVED require VERIFY_BEFORE_RETRY or NEVER_AUTOMATIC, READ_ONLY requires SAFE_READ_ONLY
at least one Task must be mandatory and no mandatory Task may depend on an optional Task
each Task requires 1..=32 verification specifications

notes: Return exactly one JSON object. Any additional property is refused.
Echo goal_id and goal_revision from the host-issued WorkItem request.
Never claim that work ran, and never author durable Task ids.

conditions.detail: the host records each evidence item as a structured observation whose requirement_id is the item's `kind`; every request.verification entry of kind STRUCTURED_EVIDENCE must therefore appear as an evidence item with `kind` equal to that entry's requirement_id, or the Task Verifier reports the requirement as missing and the Task is blocked
goal_id, task_id, attempt_id, goal_revision and plan_revision must equal the host-issued WorkItem identity; a mismatch is READONLY_IDENTITY_MISMATCH
status is exactly one of candidate_complete, blocked, needs_replan, failed; the host never accepts a model-declared completion such as COMPLETED
the sum of kind plus value bytes across all evidence items must not exceed the host total bound
an object carrying proposed_operations or any write field is refused: the read-only role has no write authority

notes: Return exactly one JSON object. Any additional property is refused.
The read-only role performs no writes and has no write authority.
candidate_complete hands the Task to the host Verifier; it is not a completion claim.
Echo every request.verification STRUCTURED_EVIDENCE requirement_id as an evidence item `kind`, with the observation in `value`. The host keys structured observations by that string.

status is exactly one of candidate_complete, blocked, needs_replan, failed
status candidate_complete requires 1..=32 proposed_operations; any other status requires 0
expected_preimage is either {kind:SHA256, sha256:<64 lowercase hex>} or {kind:ABSENT}; a mismatched preimage is refused before any write
paths must stay inside the granted write scope, single-file content is bounded, and total write content is bounded
the model never authorizes itself: the host checks the Owner grant, scope and preimage independently of this response

The writer role proposes; only the host validates the Owner grant, scope, preimage and postimage.

blocking_findings is a non-negative integer count; the host decides whether the review gate passes
a reviewer response never completes a Task or a Goal; completion needs the host Verifier and Finalizer

blocking_findings is a count, not a verdict: the host applies the review gate.

conditions.detail: goal_id, base_goal_revision and base_plan_revision must equal the values the host issued
ordinary replanning uses only the additive fields; history is never rewritten and authority is never weakened
resolve_needs_replan is a JSON array of existing Task id strings, never a boolean; each listed Task must also gain a new hard dependency in this proposal's add_dependencies

each id in resolve_needs_replan must be the `task` of an add_dependencies entry in the same proposal, so the blocked Task gains a new hard dependency; the `dependency` is that Task's new prerequisite, which is normally a repair Task added by this same proposal (`ref_kind` `NEW`), and an existing Task (`ref_kind` `EXISTING`) is also accepted; a resolution without such an edge is refused as REPLANNER_SCHEMA_VIOLATION
pristine_plan_supersession and replace_tasks may not be combined with the additive fields, with each other, or with a scope wider than the Task being replaced

when the host recorded a pre-execution plan rejection with the REQUIRE_READONLY_REASSESSMENT policy and that rejected trigger is resolved, the trigger's dependency chain must either already contain a READ_ONLY Task created after the rejected plan revision that is completed with a passed verification, no blockers, at least one evidence item and no UNKNOWN side effect, or contain a new Task that is CODEX_READONLY with READ_ONLY scope and SAFE_READ_ONLY replay safety; when the new prerequisite is used, every new Task whose operation_kind is not READ_ONLY must also depend on it
the host revalidates every proposal against the complete durable Goal; a rejection changes no plan revision, no history and no file

notes: Return exactly one JSON object. Any additional property is refused.
Additive replanning is monotonic: add Tasks, dependencies, verification, mandatory flags, criterion bindings, or resolve needs_replan.
Replacement primitives are typed and travel with explicit request ids issued by the host.

resolve a NEEDS_REPLAN Task by adding the repair Task and pointing the blocked Task at it in the same proposal (a fragment of the full replanner object, not a complete answer): {"add_dependencies":[{"task":{"ref_kind":"EXISTING","task_id":"<blocked-task-id>"},"dependency":{"ref_kind":"NEW","proposal_id":"<new-repair-proposal_id>"}}],"resolve_needs_replan":["<blocked-task-id>"]}

A Task whose own shape was already too large, too broad, or outside its budget can never succeed on an unchanged replay: resolving it adds the repair prerequisite but the host will never re-arm that Task, so it can only be finalised through replace_tasks.
